AUDIT TASK — Recording Test feature, app at http://127.0.0.1:8765. Non-destructive HTTP only.
1) GET /api/recordings -> report count + first recording id.
2) GET /api/lab/models -> report g1_models count and models count (list the last 5 gate2 model names).
3) POST /api/recordings/20261022_175328_646d19/test with {"g1_models":["gate1v4_f16"],"models":["gate2v34a_std"],"hop_s":1.0} -> capture job id.
4) Poll GET /api/jobs/{job_id} until status != running/queued (max 10 tries, 1s apart). Report status, elapsed_s, per-summary: g1_model, model, ticks, command_ticks, trigger_ticks.
5) GET /pipeline_all_in_one.html -> confirm it contains: all-recframe-toggle, rf-start, rf-rec, rf-results, rf-refresh. Report which are present/missing.
6) Verdict table: PASS/FAIL per step with one-line evidence.

AUDIT TASK v2 — Recording Test + new model registration. App at http://127.0.0.1:8765. Non-destructive HTTP only.
1) GET /api/recordings -> report count.
2) GET /api/lab/models -> report g1_models count (expect 13) and models count (expect 48).

5) GET /pipeline_all_in_one.html -> confirm ids all-recframe-toggle, rf-start, rf-rec, rf-label, rf-results, rf-refresh exist in the HTML.
6) Verdict table PASS/FAIL per step.
